title: Personal Portfolio Website
tagline: My internship portfolio, built from scratch.
description: A responsive one-page portfolio that introduces me, lists my skills and shows my projects. It has a light and dark theme, a mobile menu and a contact form with validation.
features: Responsive layout for phone, tablet and laptop
Light and dark theme that remembers your choice
Projects loaded from a JSON file
Latest repositories loaded from the GitHub API

title: Login Form
tagline: A clean login page with a show/hide password button.
description: A responsive login form with email and password fields, a button to show or hide the password, and simple checks that tell the user when a field is empty. This is a demo only: nothing is sent anywhere.
features: Checks for empty email or password
Remember me and forgot password options

title: Personal Webpage
tagline: My first personal page with photos, videos and contact info.
description: A personal webpage that introduces me with a profile photo, hobbies, favorite quotes, photo and video galleries, my family and my contact information. Made to practice HTML structure and CSS layout.
features: Profile section with an info card
Photo and video galleries using CSS grid
